figures.sample: derived from the probability channel formula used for B1-B16, with f and theta set from the B17 evidence base

derivation: Probability channel: eps_P = 10 x ((1-PoS)/PoS) x f x theta with PoS = 0.12 so (1-PoS)/PoS = 7.33, matching Agent C's model. f = share of attrition attributable to design rather than to target biology or molecule properties: set at 0.15-0.25, bounded below by the 17 percent of Phase 3 failures attributed to safety at a chosen dose [E-9515] plus the commercial-strategy failures, and bounded above so as not to double-count B1. theta = pass-through of a 10 percent design improvement, set at 0.20-0.40, higher than B1's 0.15-0.45 midpoint because design choices are observable and controllable ex ante, unlike target validity. Low: 10 x 7.33 x 0.15 x 0.20 = 2.2. Point: 10 x 7.33 x 0.20 x 0.28 = 4.1. High: 10 x 7.33 x 0.25 x 0.38 = 7.0. Band 2 - 4 - 7. The upper bound is held below the 2x to 6.7x enrichment effect reported in [E-9541] because that effect is confounded by indication and sponsor and because the sotorasib case [E-9543] shows a rigorous design exercise can return no gain.
